messages:
maria: Proposal — pivot from full escrow to a witness model for BYOK HSMs. Two main asks: (1) RBAC: separate 'wrap/unwrap' from 'admin-import' roles; (2) Audit window: keep wrap/unwrap events for 7 years, operator actions for 90 days. Thoughts? @samir @alyssa

samir: +1 on split roles. question: do we need a new cryptographic policy to enforce unwrap-only on service principals? Or can we rely on HSM key attributes?

alyssa: HSMs (Thales/Luna) support usage attributes. I think set 'exportable=false' and create an unwrap-only wrapper key for service principals. Ops still needs admin-import for rotate/import.

jordan: For audit: 7 years for customer key wraps is heavy — legal wants 7y for some customers. storage cost estimate? We can TTL compressed logs after 12 months but keep signed digests longer.

maria: Good call. Cost note: S3 Glacier for digests. We also need tamper-evident chain — propose monthly digest signed with cluster KMS.

leah: How about operator shift handovers? We should require dual-operator approval for any import/restore outside maintenance windows. Add a one-time HSM challenge-response token.

samir: On vuln triage: suppose HSM firmware advisory impacts wrapping primitive. We need a runbook: (a) stop imports; (b) route new wraps to fallback KMS variant; (c) notify affected customers. Anyone work on fallback model mapping?

alyssa: I sketched mapping in GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/hsm-fallback-mapping (WIP). For fallback we can route to 'redwood-hosted-hsm-compat' with alerts. Also add automatic rollback if wrap failure > 1%.

maria: Ops question — audit queries. Example to surface operator approvals:
```
SELECT timestamp, actor, action, key_id, approval_ticket FROM audit_logs WHERE action IN ('import','restore') AND key_id='cust-key-123' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50;
```

jordan: Nice. Add 'firmware_version' and 'hsm_serial' to the view so we can detect if action happened on patched device.

leah: Incident response note: create a canned customer notification template for BYOK incidents. Include status, affected operations, mitigation steps, expected ETA.

samir: ACK. I'll draft the template. Also doc for RBAC change: propose new roles: hsm.wrap, hsm.unwrap, hsm.import, hsm.admin, hsm.audit-read.

sre-bot: Deploy plan created: PR #4927 adding roles and audit retention pipeline. Canaries scheduled tonight in staging.

maria: Thanks. Action items: samir draft RBAC PR, leah draft customer template, alyssa/ops validate fallback mapping, jordan add firmware fields to audit view. Ping here when PRs exist. :thumbsup:
